recreation_brief:
1. Set the slide background fill to light gray (#F0F0F0).
2. Add a thin black border frame around the slide perimeter.
3. Insert a centered text box in the upper-middle area. Type line 1: '[2] Ridge Regularization to overcome' and line 2: 'Inverse Problem of Singular Matrix'. Use a bold sans-serif font, dark red color (#C00000), and center alignment. Apply an underline to the second line only.
4. Insert a small oval shape in the top-right corner. Fill it bright yellow (#FFFF00) and add the text '20' in small black sans-serif font, centered.
5. Optionally, place a standard mouse cursor arrow near the bottom-center to match the screenshot exactly.
